capabilities: Show remaining reading time and percent read in the status bar or a mobile pill
Count reading time for prose only, excluding code, embeds, comments and URLs
Resume reading at a saved position with a chip
Mark notes as read by writing a read property when scrolled to the end
Show reading time for selected text via a command
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.4.4 or newer. On mobile it hides other status bar items by default and documents a CSS selector for restyling its pill.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of Remaining reading time by ununnamed, MIT-licensed.
problem: Obsidian's word count tells you a note's length but not how much reading time is left or how far through the note you are.
